TXT 转换：全部可用目标TXT conversions: every available target

纯文本没有结构，只有字符与换行。这条管线因此不假装认得标题或列表：转成 HTML 时整段放进 `<pre>`，转成文档时保留空白与等宽排版。唯一的例外是文本本身就是 JSON——那时它才有行列可谈，数据类目标也才成立。Plain text has characters and line breaks, not structure. This pipeline therefore does not pretend to recognise headings or lists: HTML wraps the text in `<pre>`, and document routes keep whitespace and a monospace layout. The one exception is text that is already JSON — only then are there rows and columns, and only then do the data targets apply.

全部可用目标Every available target

  • MarkdownMarkdown 1 步1 step

    纯文本 (TXT)plain text (TXT) →MarkdownMarkdown

    浏览器本地把 .txt 包成带围栏的 Markdown 代码块：内容原样保留，围栏长度会按文本里出现的最长反引号串加长，所以你的三反引号不会把结构撑破。它不猜标题、不猜列表——那是"值保真"与"替你排版"的区别。Wrap a .txt in a fenced Markdown code block verbatim: the fence grows past the longest run of backticks in your text, and it guesses no headings or lists.

    有专页 →Full page →

  • HTMLHTML 1 步1 step

    纯文本 (TXT)plain text (TXT) →HTMLHTML

    文本按字面转义后放进 `<pre>`：换行与空格保留，`<` 与 `&` 变成实体，不会被当作标签执行；不识别标题、列表或表格。The text is escaped literally into `<pre>`: line breaks and spaces survive, `<` and `&` become entities and are never executed, and no heading, list or table is inferred.

  • Word (.docx)Word (.docx) 2 步2 steps

    纯文本 (TXT)plain text (TXT) →HTMLHTML →Word (.docx)Word (.docx)

    把纯文本变成 Word 打得开的 .docx：换行、缩进与制表符原样保留，排版交给 Word。批量、可预览、零网络请求，不经过任何在线转换服务。A plain-text file becomes a .docx Word opens: line breaks, indentation and tabs preserved, layout left to Word. Fully offline, never sent to a service.

    有专页 →Full page →

  • PDFPDF 2 步2 steps

    纯文本 (TXT)plain text (TXT) →HTMLHTML →PDFPDF

    在浏览器里把 .txt 排成 PDF：整篇进一个 <pre> 块，缩进与对齐照原样保留，再按 A4 切页。不上传、不联网。The whole file goes into one <pre> block, so indentation survives, then it is cut into A4 pages. Offline, in your browser.

    有专页 →Full page →

  • Excel (.xlsx)Excel (.xlsx) 4 步4 steps

    纯文本 (TXT)plain text (TXT) →HTMLHTML →JSONJSON →CSVCSV →Excel (.xlsx)Excel (.xlsx)

    只有当整段文本是合法 JSON 数组时才走得通：TXT→HTML 后按 JSON 读取，再转成表格。普通文本没有表格结构，会以错误结束。It only works when the whole text is a valid JSON array: after TXT→HTML the content is read as JSON and turned into a sheet. Ordinary prose has no table structure and ends in an error.

  • CSVCSV 3 步3 steps

    纯文本 (TXT)plain text (TXT) →HTMLHTML →JSONJSON →CSVCSV

    同样要求文本是合法 JSON 数组；对象数组的键成为 CSV 表头。不是 JSON 的纯文本无法建立列，转换会失败。The text must again be a valid JSON array, with the keys of its objects becoming CSV headers. Prose that is not JSON cannot supply columns, so the route fails.

  • JSONJSON 2 步2 steps

    纯文本 (TXT)plain text (TXT) →HTMLHTML →JSONJSON

    把 `<pre>` 里的文本当作 JSON 解析并格式化：原文本身是 JSON 时得到缩进版本；不是 JSON 时报解析错误，原文不会被包成一个字符串。The text inside `<pre>` is parsed as JSON and pretty-printed: JSON input comes back indented, and non-JSON reports a parse error instead of wrapping the text in a string.

  • PNGPNG 2 步2 steps

    纯文本 (TXT)plain text (TXT) →HTMLHTML →PNGPNG

    按等宽 `<pre>` 排版整页渲染成 PNG，空白与换行保留；高度超过 32768 px 时报错而不是截断。The monospace `<pre>` layout is captured whole as PNG, preserving whitespace and line breaks; past 32768 px of height the route fails rather than truncating.

  • JPEGJPEG 3 步3 steps

    纯文本 (TXT)plain text (TXT) →HTMLHTML →PDFPDF →JPEGJPEG

    按 A4 分页、逐页编码 JPEG，多页 ZIP；等宽文字在 JPEG 下会出现边缘振铃，适合预览。It is sliced into A4 pages and encoded as JPEG, with several pages in a ZIP. JPEG ringing shows on monospace glyph edges, so this suits previews.

  • WebPWebP 3 步3 steps

    纯文本 (TXT)plain text (TXT) →HTMLHTML →PDFPDF →WebPWebP

    同样按 A4 分页并编码 WebP；多页 ZIP。文本类内容用有损格式体积收益有限，清晰度会下降。The same A4 slicing and a WebP encoder, with several pages in a ZIP. Lossy compression buys little on text and costs some sharpness.

这个来源格式的共同限制What holds for every target from this source

  • 没有 Markdown 推断：`# 标题` 与 `- 列表` 保持字面字符，不会被解释成结构No Markdown inference: `# heading` and `- item` stay literal characters and are never interpreted as structure
  • Excel、CSV 与 JSON 路线只对「整段内容是合法 JSON」的文本成立；普通文本会明确报错Excel, CSV and JSON routes only work when the whole text is valid JSON; ordinary prose fails explicitly
  • HTML 路线把整段放进 `<pre>`，超长行不会自动折行；图片与 PDF 路线按页面宽度排版The HTML route wraps everything in `<pre>`, so very long lines do not wrap; image and PDF routes lay out to page width
  • 编码判定与 CSV / JSON 相同：UTF-16（BOM 或 NUL 形状）、UTF-8、GB18030、GBK，最后过控制字符闸门Encoding detection matches CSV and JSON: UTF-16 by BOM or NUL shape, then UTF-8, GB18030 and GBK, with a control-character gate

常见问题Questions people actually ask

TXT 转 HTML 会认 Markdown 吗？Does TXT to HTML understand Markdown?

不会。文本按字面转义后放进 `<pre>`，`#`、`*` 与反引号都只是字符。要渲染 Markdown，请先把文件后缀改成 `.md` 再转。No. The text is escaped literally inside `<pre>`, so `#`, `*` and backticks stay characters. To render Markdown, rename the file to `.md` first.

为什么 TXT 转 Excel 报错？Why does TXT to Excel fail?

因为纯文本没有行列。转换器把文本放进 `<pre>` 后，只有一种情况能建立表格：整段文本是合法的 JSON 数组。否则它明确报错，而不是把每一行塞进一格。Because plain text has no rows or columns. After wrapping the text in `<pre>`, the only way to build a table is for the whole text to be a valid JSON array. Otherwise the route fails rather than forcing every line into a cell.

换行与空格会保留吗？Are line breaks and spaces preserved?

HTML 与 Word 路线用 `<pre>` 与等宽排版保留它们；TXT 与 Markdown 路线原样搬运。图片与 PDF 路线按页面排版，超长行可能被页面宽度限制。The HTML and Word routes keep them through `<pre>` and a monospace layout, and the TXT and Markdown routes carry them verbatim. Image and PDF routes lay out to a page, where very long lines meet the page width.

能读 UTF-16 或 GBK 的文本吗？Can it read UTF-16 or GBK text?

能。先按 BOM 与 NUL 的奇偶形状识别 UTF-16，再走严格 UTF-8、GB18030、GBK；解出的文字若含三个以上非空白控制字符，会被判为「这不是文本」而不是继续产出。Yes. UTF-16 is recognised from its BOM or NUL parity, then strict UTF-8, GB18030 and GBK are tried in order. If the decoded text carries three or more non-whitespace control characters, it is rejected as not text rather than written out.
